summary: 17 scalp-tissue LFQ runs (female/male AGA vs normal) match the deposit; instrument, NCE and MS1 range confirmed from RAW headers; only minor findings.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent; no producer transcript, report.md or prior reviews read; evidence limited to the dataset's scratchpad folder plus re-fetched PRIDE/Europe PMC/OLS/Cellosaurus and RAW-header byte ranges

spec_compliance.evidence: Templates ms-proteomics v1.1.0 + human v1.1.0 declared and appropriate (human tissue, DDA); column set/order accepted by validator; ms1 scan range and collision energy match TERMS.tsv patterns; source+assay unique.

ontology_integrity.evidence: sdrf-tools check 12/12 verified; OLS exact: androgenetic alopecia MONDO:0005339, scalp UBERON:0000403 (not obsolete); Q Exactive Plus MS:1002634, HCD MS:1000422, Trypsin MS:1001251, UNIMOD:4/35 verified by check.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE protocol: DTT/IAA, trypsin, Q Exactive Plus, HCD NCE 27%, 350-1400 m/z, Carbamidomethyl C fixed / Oxidation M variable. RAW header ranges of FA1.raw and MN2.raw: 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS', serial TMOQEPLUS, scan range 350 to 1400 m/z, nce 27, path 'Hair loss Project'. PRIDE structured 'Q Exactive HF' correctly overridden. Europe PMC PMID 39460779 abstract: male AGA and female AGA scalp samples with respective normal controls.

file_mapping.evidence: files.json (projectAccessions==PXD052630) lists 17 RAW; SDRF has 17 unique comment[data file] values, symmetric difference empty; .mgf/.msf correctly excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: FA 6, FN 2, MA 7, MN 2 = 17 individuals, one run each (technical replicate 1, fraction 1); factors disease x sex form the paper's 2x2 design; no confounding beyond the design itself.

omission_safety.evidence: Age, developmental stage, tolerances set to 'not available' (no per-sample source); no PTMs, fractionation or labels beyond protocol; per-sample group assignment is inferred from file codes (flagged minor) but consistent with abstract design.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human: 'Everything seems to be fine' exit 0; default run also clean; sdrf-tools check CLEAN exit 0; sdrf-tools score 97/100 exit 0.

findings.evidence: Abstract/PRIDE describe male AGA, female AGA and respective controls; RAW headers carry only file names. Consistent, but confirm counts against paper Methods if obtainable.
